sections.text: On Android: Swipe down from the top of the screen to open Quick Settings. Tap Font Size. Tap Increase or Decrease, or drag the percentage slider left or right. If you haven't added the Font Size tile to Quick Settings, you must add it first. If you adjust the font size from Settings, the Font Size tile will be automatically added in Quick Settings. You can adjust font size up to 200%.
